public.text: I both completely agree that this is true and disagree that this should be accepted as a ground truth. Sometimes a blank slate is necessary to achieve a step change, sometimes simply to allow free thinking so the installed base can be evolved in ways that would not otherwise have been possible.
public.suggestedRevision:
I would either explore this contention or remove the implied position that a blank slate approach is "wrong"
I would refer again to parallel development (operational and theoretical) and would also invite the theoretical to be undertaken from the premise (if not the reality) of a blank slate and to do so with the only truly universal patient population who are (from a data perspective) essentially blank slates!
REDDHI is too pragmatic if a better position the continuing any status quo
